sources.title: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited: Annual Environmental Report 2025, IE licence P1187-01 (Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus, Unit 75 Grange Castle Business Park)
sources.publisher: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited, published by the Environmental Protection Agency (Ireland)
sources.attribution: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited via EPA LEAP
sources.summary: The licensee's AER for 1 January to 31 December 2025 describes the facility as a data storage installation in Grange Castle South Business Park licensed under P1187-01 for back-up generators and a standby gas generation plant, and states that the licence covers DUB14, DUB15 and the CAB administration building. It reports that from January 2025 part of the gas plant was handed over to support live load at the DUB15 data centre while the remainder of the DUB15 site remained under construction and commissioning, that the CAB building became operational in March 2025, that DUB14 became fully loaded across its colocation IT environment during 2025, and that DUB15 continued phased deployment and commissioning across colocation spaces; 10 of the 22 gas engines became operational in 2025.
sources.date_semantics: AER filed with the EPA and posted to LEAP on 30 April 2026 (published_at), outside the admission window. Used only for the installation's building identity and scope (DUB14, DUB15 and CAB) and to bound the claim (DUB15 phased commissioning); not a status observation.

sources.title: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited: Annual Environmental Report 2025, IE licence P1190-01 (Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus, Unit 74-76 Grange Castle Business Park)
sources.publisher: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited, published by the Environmental Protection Agency (Ireland)
sources.attribution: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited via EPA LEAP
sources.summary: The licensee's AER for 2025 describes the facility as a data storage installation in Grange Castle South Business Park licensed under P1190-01 for back-up generators, and states that the licence covers DB3-DB5. It reports that the back-up generators run on HVO, attended noise monitoring in Q4 2025, stormwater from DB3, DB4 and DB5, and higher 2025 water use attributed to construction and decommissioning activity across the campus and to maintenance and recommissioning of older equipment and legacy rooms; it does not say that DB3, DB4 or DB5 has ceased operation.
sources.date_semantics: AER filed with the EPA and posted to LEAP on 30 April 2026 (published_at), outside the admission window. Used only for building identity (DB3-DB5) and scope context; not a status observation.

sources.title: EdgeConneX: Dublin, Ireland - DUB01 & DUB02 Dublin Data Centers page (version modified 27 August 2026)
sources.summary: EdgeConneX's Dublin location page, headed 'DUB01 & DUB02 Dublin Data Centers', says EdgeConneX holds a large, land-banked parcel in Dublin that currently houses two purpose-built data centers and property available for new data center builds, that it is operational and power banked for a total of over 170 MW, and that it supports two existing and up to five new data centers in the Grange Castle Business Park. Its specifications list 2 data centers with a land bank for up to 5 more, 32 MW N+1 of power (DUB01: 18 MW N+1, DUB02: 7 MW N+1, DUB03: 7 MW N+1 planned), a power bank for an additional 100 MW, N+1 CRACs, 24/7 NOC and security, and network providers present at the building.
sources.date_semantics: Structured data give datePublished 2018-10-30 and dateModified 2026-08-27T09:35:44Z, matching the data-center sitemap lastmod (uk-devolved-ie-p4-edgeconnex-data-center-sitemap). The version is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 2 August 2026 (uk-devolved-ie-p4-edgeconnex-dublin-page-ia-20260802; dateModified 2026-03-23, the same two-data-centre and 'operational' statements) and above by the copy of 3 September 2026 (uk-devolved-ie-p4-edgeconnex-dublin-page-ia-20260903; dateModified 2026-08-27, identical statements); the 4 October 2026 copy and the live capture of 26 October 2026 (UTC) carry the same version. published_at records the modification day; the operating statement is used as of that day, not as an opening or inspection date. Power figures are N+1 facility ratings, not measured IT load.
sources.pages_reviewed: whole page (HTML text and structured data)
